thread:
Maria Lopez: Heads-up — noticed the KB page for routing policy has a bad canonical URL (404) when hitting the /guides path. New hire @Devon took a look and said they'd claim it, but pinging for review + quick CR so we can unstick onboarding docs.
Devon Chen: I grabbed it, created a tiny PR that swaps the canonical to the stable slug. link: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/8321
Devon Chen: Patch is just one line — replace /guides/runtime with /guides/runtime/overview. CI flake on image snapshot is unrelated.
DocsBot: Automated scan: KB link-checker flagged /guides/runtime -> 404 on 2024-11-02 16:12:03 UTC. PR referenced: #8321.
Alex Patel: looking now, will do a quick sanity pass. can you paste the sed you used so I can run locally?
Devon Chen: sure — quick local fix I ran:
```bash
# from repo root
sed -n '1,200p' content/kb/routing.md | sed "s|/guides/runtime\b|/guides/runtime/overview|g" > tmp && mv tmp content/kb/routing.md
```
Alex Patel: ran it, preview looks good. leaving one tiny nits comment in the PR about relative vs absolute URLs but not blocking.
Samir Rao: If DocsBot scan is green after merge we should probably backfill a redirect rule for the old slug so external links don't break. can we add a short follow-up ticket?
Maria Lopez: yep — created ticket RW-2145 to add a redirect + update the sitemap (assigned to platform-ops).
Devon Chen: addressed Alex's nit and pushed an amend, CI is running again. cc @Alex @Samir
Alex Patel: LGTM, left an approval. :thumbsup:
DocsBot: PR #8321 merged by Devon Chen at 2024-11-02T16:24:51Z — link check re-run queued.
Maria Lopez: thanks everyone — leaving this thread for async follow-ups, but callout for platform-ops to pick up RW-2145.
Samir Rao: noted, I'll take RW-2145 and post a short rollout plan once I have infra window.
Maria Lopez: awesome — closing the loop here. :raised_hands:
